sql.user.findByEmailIgnoreCase: select id, first_name, last_name, email, password, company_id, first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, user_status_type_id from flow.user where lower(email) = lower(:email)
sql.user.findByUserUuid: select id, first_name, last_name, first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, user_status_type_id from flow.user where uuid = :uuid
sql.user.findUserById: select id, first_name, last_name, first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, user_status_type_id from flow.user where id = :id
